basis: Inherited skeletal muscle degeneration; cardiac and respiratory involvement varies across subtypes and is not established in most patients.
Primary microcephaly with abnormal cortical gyration is a developmental brain disorder.
GPI-anchor glycosylation disorder with seizures and developmental disability; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Hypotonia does not establish primary muscle damage.
Complete or partial gonadal dysgenesis compromises testicular endocrine function; the cardiac ancestry and gene alone do not establish cardiac involvement.
Pancraniosynostosis defines skeletal disease; basal-ganglia calcification has no established functional injury, with normal intelligence and favorable neurologic outcome.
Malignant neoplasm involving the femur.
Developmental disability and nail/digital hypoplasia define the syndrome; hearing impairment occurs in 4/8. Constipation alone does not establish intestinal damage.
Benign endometrial neoplasm is confined to a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Skeletal dysplasia and brain anomalies define disease; renal abnormalities/hydronephrosis and respiratory failure each occur in 80-99%; sparse hair omitted by cap.
Heart failure with elevated cardiac output; underlying causes do not establish additional organ involvement.
Congenital intraoral band fixes the tongue to the palate or alveolar ridge, directly affecting oral function.
Workplace contact dermatitis affects skin; the umbrella includes irritant disease and does not uniformly imply an immune mechanism.
Malignant neoplasm of the hard palate, an oral cavity site.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss.
Osteosclerosis with recurrent fractures and ichthyosis defines bone and skin disease.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder; KCND3-associated neurologic diseases are separate phenotypes.
Microcornea/glaucoma and frontal sinus aplasia define disease; palmoplantar keratoderma occurs in 80-99%. Torus palatinus does not establish functional injury.
Cerebral impairment of color recognition despite preserved color perception; no intrinsic eye disease is implied.
Ischemic injury of the posterior optic nerve causes visual loss; optic nerve is included in the ocular axis.
Inherited reflex epilepsy triggered by hot water.
Gonococcal infection directly inflames a synovial bursa.
Immune-mediated transmural intestinal inflammation and fibrosis; individual extraintestinal organ complications do not reliably meet the 30% threshold.
Immune-mediated giant-cell inflammation directly destroys myocardium, causing arrhythmias and heart failure.
LPIN1-related metabolic disease causes recurrent skeletal muscle breakdown; myoglobinuria does not itself establish kidney injury, whose frequency is unspecified.
Immune-mediated inflammation diffusely affects renal glomeruli and causes renal failure.
